query: select category, count(*) as story_count, count(*) filter (where published = true) as published_count, count(*) filter (where is_approved = true) as approved_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(length(content),0) >= 1200) as detailed_count, round(avg(length(coalesce(content,'')))::numeric, 0) as avg_chars from public.stories group by category order by category limit 50
